use bytes::Bytes;
use onc_rpc_xdr::{XdrDecode, XdrEncode};

pub const BODY_MAX: i64 = 16;

pub type data = Bytes;

pub type alias = data;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct record {
    pub ratio: f32,
    pub value: alias,
}

impl XdrEncode for record {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.ratio.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.value.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for record {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            ratio: <f32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            value: <alias as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for record {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.ratio, output)?;
        output.opaque(&self.value, Some(BODY_MAX as usize))?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub type optional_record = Option<Box<record>>;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct wrapper {
    pub body: optional_record,
}

impl XdrEncode for wrapper {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.body.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for wrapper {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            body: <optional_record as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for wrapper {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.body, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum response {
    True {
        value: wrapper,
    },
    False,
}

impl XdrEncode for response {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::True { value } => {
                (true).encode_xdr(output)?;
                value.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::False => {
                (false).encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for response {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        let discriminant = <bool as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?;
        match discriminant {
            true => Ok(Self::True { value: <wrapper as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            false => Ok(Self::False),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for response {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::True { value } => {
                output.encode(&(true))?;
                onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&value, output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::False => {
                output.encode(&(false))?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
pub type dataMetadata = onc_rpc_xdr::OpaqueLength<{ BODY_MAX as usize }>;

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
pub type aliasMetadata = dataMetadata;

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct recordMetadata {
    pub ratio: f32,
    pub value: aliasMetadata,
}

impl XdrDecode for recordMetadata {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            ratio: <f32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            value: <aliasMetadata as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata for recordMetadata {
    const MAX_PREFIX_BYTES: usize = 8;
    fn opaque_len(&self) -> Option<usize> { onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata::opaque_len(&self.value) }
}

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
pub type optional_recordMetadata = Option<Box<recordMetadata>>;

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct wrapperMetadata {
    pub body: optional_recordMetadata,
}

impl XdrDecode for wrapperMetadata {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            body: <optional_recordMetadata as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata for wrapperMetadata {
    const MAX_PREFIX_BYTES: usize = 12;
    fn opaque_len(&self) -> Option<usize> { onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata::opaque_len(&self.body) }
}

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum responseMetadata {
    True {
        value: wrapperMetadata,
    },
    False,
}

impl XdrDecode for responseMetadata {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        let discriminant = <bool as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?;
        match discriminant {
            true => Ok(Self::True { value: <wrapperMetadata as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            false => Ok(Self::False),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata for responseMetadata {
    const MAX_PREFIX_BYTES: usize = 16;
    fn opaque_len(&self) -> Option<usize> { match self { Self::True { value } => onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata::opaque_len(value), Self::False => None, } }
}

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
pub type dataSegments = onc_rpc_xdr::OpaqueSegments<{ BODY_MAX as usize }>;

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
pub type aliasSegments = dataSegments;

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct recordSegments {
    pub ratio: f32,
    pub value: aliasSegments,
}

impl XdrEncode for recordSegments {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.ratio.encode_xdr(output)?;
        self.value.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for recordSegments {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            ratio: <f32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            value: <aliasSegments as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for recordSegments {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.ratio, output)?;
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.value, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl From<record> for recordSegments {
    fn from(value: record) -> Self { Self {
        ratio: value.ratio,
        value: value.value.into(),
    } }
}

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
pub type optional_recordSegments = Option<Box<recordSegments>>;

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct wrapperSegments {
    pub body: optional_recordSegments,
}

impl XdrEncode for wrapperSegments {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.body.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for wrapperSegments {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            body: <optional_recordSegments as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for wrapperSegments {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.body, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl From<wrapper> for wrapperSegments {
    fn from(value: wrapper) -> Self { Self {
        body: value.body.map(|value| Box::new((*value).into())),
    } }
}

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum responseSegments {
    True {
        value: wrapperSegments,
    },
    False,
}

impl XdrEncode for responseSegments {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::True { value } => {
                (true).encode_xdr(output)?;
                value.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::False => {
                (false).encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for responseSegments {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        let discriminant = <bool as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?;
        match discriminant {
            true => Ok(Self::True { value: <wrapperSegments as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            false => Ok(Self::False),
        }
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for responseSegments {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::True { value } => {
                output.encode(&(true))?;
                onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&value, output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::False => {
                output.encode(&(false))?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

impl From<response> for responseSegments {
    fn from(value: response) -> Self { match value {
        response::True { value } => Self::True { value: value.into() },
        response::False => Self::False,
    } }
}
